result.question: Quais são os 3 diagnósticos principais mais comuns entre pacientes com mais de 60 anos no estado de MA e no estado do RS?
result.gold_sql:
SELECT estado, "DESCRICAO", total
FROM (
    SELECT mu."SG_UF" AS estado,
           c."DESCRICAO",
           COUNT(*) AS total,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu."SG_UF" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID"
    WHERE i."IDADE" > 60 AND mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS')
    GROUP BY mu."SG_UF", c."DESCRICAO"
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY estado, rn;
